cues: Make sure this part of your ankle is facing left diagonal

steps_taught.name: Right Outer-lock
steps_taught.description: Step with toe facing left diagonal, put heel down facing right diagonal, pick up toes facing right diagonal.

steps_taught.name: Left Outer-lock
steps_taught.description: Step with toe facing right diagonal, put heel down facing left diagonal, pick up toes facing left diagonal.

steps_taught.name: Dual Outer-locks
steps_taught.description: Performing right and left outer-locks at the same time with right foot in front and left at the back.

what_works: Close-up footwork shots make foot positioning clear
Counting aloud helps keep rhythm during slow practice
what_hinders: Static camera angles do not show full body alignment well

quotes.text: Today I'm gonna teach you right, left and dual outer-locks.
Now I'm gonna mix everything all together.

extraction.distinctive_method: Using physical hand gestures to point directly at shoe parts and angles while explaining foot placement.
